title: Frozen ECRO conditional transport readout: feasibility and cost-normalized variance reduction
class: regular numbered batch (owner-designated); bounded architecture-feasibility experiment

hypothesis.H1: Conditional HIGH readout reduces the MSE of the frozen ECRO TOTAL estimator at equal measured GPU time without material change in expectation.
hypothesis.H0: Any HIGH variance reduction is offset by changed LOW/HIGH covariance, approximation bias or additional cost.

frozen: WL100 SSS checkpoint, learned HIGH table bytes, table generation, source encoding, patch/bin discretization, event ownership
LOW = E1 + E2 statements and the main PCG32 stream (J jitter, P first-event continuation, S k=2 walk)
geometry, materials, lights, camera contract, original sampling distributions, WL101 renderer (rt101.py, pt100.py, pt86.py unchanged)
WL103-WL108 artifacts and verdicts; contact disk excluded from every primary decision

estimator.R0: rt101.RT._frame_prog (pt100.Ctx.trace ER, kmax 2, mode ecro): TOTAL = E1 + E2 + T(X) B[a(X)], HIGH read at the second hit with the shared first-event sample
estimator.C1: H_C1(U) = (1/M) sum_m T(U,P'_m) B[a(U,P'_m)]; U = first camera interaction (function of J); P'_m = M fresh first-event continuations (NEE-free SSS walk then closure sample, original statements and distributions) from an independent TEA-seeded PCG32 stream; LOW unchanged and bitwise-paired with R0 for the same seed
estimator.target_expectation: E[TOTAL_R0] of the frozen renderer; E[H_C1 | U] = E[H | U] so E[TOTAL_C1] = E[TOTAL_R0]
estimator.description_rule: finite unbiased inner Monte Carlo estimate of the conditional expectation; never described as exact integration
estimator.exact_integration: not used: the visible (patch, bin) partition of the first-hit hemisphere depends on continuous position and visibility
estimator.inner_samples_exclude_shared_sample: fixed a priori from WL103: Cov(LOW,HIGH) through the shared first-event sample is positive in every ROI

views.note: dev = WL105 training cameras; evaluation views were inspected by WL105-WL108, so no out-of-distribution generalization claim

environment.admission: experiments/ecro_denoise108/renderer108.py frozen_runtime, unchanged (sources, checkpoint, scene, learned-table hash, archived 4096-spp V0 replay)

inputs.reference: WL107 qualified frozen-ECRO assessment reference: 46 WL107 + 2 WL105 independent 8192-spp blocks per view (393,216 spp); per-pixel variance recomputed from the blocks

grid_extension_rule: if C1's measured time at a nominal spp lies outside the measured R0 grid times of its view, add R0 levels 80, 96, 128 with the grid seed rule and 32 replicates for all views before analysis; the verdict stays INCONCLUSIVE until the curve brackets C1

rois.definition: WL105 analyze105.rois on the frozen aux.npz, contact disk removed (common107 convention)
descriptive: signed distance bands -7..+7 px to the sphere silhouette

seeds.rules: paired = base + 10000 view + 100 nominal_index + r; grid = base + 10000 view + 100 grid_index + r; dev = base + 10000 dev + 100 M_index + r; synthetic = base + 100000 table + 100 config + r; timing = base + 10000 view + 100 slot + i; main-stream seed value = splitmix64((seed << 16) + launch) passed to the unchanged frame program (development finding: the historical seed * 1000003 convention gives consecutive seeds correlated pcg_046 replicate streams, excess pair correlation of the original HIGH 0.012 on a high-contrast table and 0.005 on the learned table; archived-frame replays keep the historical convention); inner stream = TEA hash of inner_seed_value(seed)

statistical.variance_rule: a variance deviation fails only if it is both material (beyond tolerance) and resolved (beyond z_max bootstrap SE)

replicate_independence.rule: excess consecutive-pair correlation of LOW, original HIGH, C1 HIGH and their difference under the protocol seeding within z_max SE of 0; the historical seed * 1000003 convention must show a resolved original-HIGH correlation on the power-control table

synthetic.stop_rule: any synthetic gate failure stops the batch; ordinary implementation bugs that preserve the declared estimator may be fixed and recorded; no replacement mechanism

development.selection: M* = argmin over M of the geometric mean over dev views of r(M) = Var_T,C1(M) t_C1(M) / (Var_T,R0 t_R0) on the primary ROI at 4 spp; ties within tie_tolerance go to the smaller M
development.futility_rule: if r(M*) > futility_ratio the batch closes NOT_SUPPORTED before any evaluation-view evidence
development.futility_disclosure: raised from 1.0 to 1.5 before the freeze, after the non-evidence development smoke on T00 indicated r(1) ~ 1.1; the evaluation stage costs < 2 GPU-hours, so the gate now closes the batch only where even a large failure of the 1/time screening assumption could not yield a benefit; the change can only add evidence and leaves every decision threshold unchanged

final.escalation_rule: only if a bias test is UNRESOLVED after 32 paired replicates: paired replicates 32..63 for every view and nominal spp (uniform, never selective), once

analysis.mse_definition: mean over replicate frames of mean_{ROI,RGB}(Y - ref)^2 minus mean_{ROI,RGB} Var(ref); relative RMSE = sqrt(MSE / mean ref^2)
analysis.equal_time: rho_v = MSE_C1,v(n) / MSE_R0,v(t_C1,v(n)); t = median synchronized frozen frame time; R0 MSE interpolated log-log between bracketing measured grid levels; GM over views; interval = normal on log GM with two-level bootstrap SE (views, then replicates and timing samples within view)
analysis.bias_rule: B1 per view x bias ROI: paired relative signed luminance bias of TOTAL_C1 - TOTAL_R0 (inverse-variance pooled over bias_spp) relative to the reference ROI luminance; EQUIVALENT if 95% CI within +-tolerance, BIASED if the CI lies outside, otherwise UNRESOLVED. B2 spatial bias power Q = mean over 8 independent replicate groups of mean_{ROI,RGB}(Dbar_g^2 - s_g^2/n_g) / pooled Var(TOTAL_R0) at each bias_spp; Student-t upper95 (7 df) <= limit

decision.P1: all synthetic gates pass (toy, structural, statistical, independence, quadrature)
decision.P4: every B1 EQUIVALENT and every B2 within limit
decision.P5: primary 16 and 32 spp: GM ratio <= 1.02 and upper95 <= 1.05
decision.P6: silhouette and sss_interior at 4/16/32 spp: GM ratio <= 1.05 and upper95 <= 1.10
decision.P7: dynamic D1-D4 correctness and D5 benefit

verdict.STOPPED_MECHANISM_INFEASIBLE: a structural synthetic gate (identity, replay, zero table, quadrature) fails and cannot be fixed without changing the declared estimator
verdict.NOT_SUPPORTED: futility, or B1 BIASED / B2 failure, or any of P2, P3, P5, P6 fails, or dynamic correctness D1-D4 fails
verdict.INCONCLUSIVE: reference precision fails, the equal-time curve cannot bracket C1, or a bias test stays UNRESOLVED after escalation
verdict.STATIC_ONLY_SUPPORTED: P1-P6 pass and dynamic correctness passes but D5 fails, or the dynamic stage cannot be executed without touching another branch

dynamic.condition: run only if the static decision passes

budget.note: stage elapsed-time caps in run109.sh; a cap hit stops the chain with its stage recorded

stop: frozen checkpoint, table, scene or source identity fails
archived WL101 4096-spp replay or archived WL105 evaluation-frame replay fails its tolerance
the conditional measure cannot be implemented with valid sampling semantics
synthetic expectation or structural gates fail
continuing would need a new estimator family, a learned model, a table change or a change to another branch
prior_art: Neural control variates, neural radiance caching, neural two-level Monte Carlo and standard conditional / stratified Monte Carlo; any variance reduction here is an application of conditional Monte Carlo (Rao-Blackwellization) and not claimed novel
